name: CustomXMLNode
description: Represents an XML node in a tree in a document. The CustomXMLNode object is a member of the CustomXMLNodes collection.
remarks: The CustomXMLNode object is designed to have functional parity with the IXMLDOMNode interface. In addition, it contains an XPath property, which is a great improvement over the objects provided by MSXML.
example:
Sub CustomXmlNodes()
    Dim cxp1 As CustomXMLPart
    Dim cxn As CustomXMLNode

    With ActiveDocument

        ' Returns the first custom xml part with the given root namespace.
        Set cxp1 = .CustomXMLParts("urn:invoice:namespace")

        ' Get the first node matching the XPath expression.
        Set cxn = cxp1.SelectSingleNode("//*[@quantity < 4]")

    End With

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for a CustomXMLNode object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLNode object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CustomXMLNode object. Read-only.

properties.name: Attributes
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLNodes collection representing the attributes of the current element in the current node. Read-only.

properties.name: BaseName
properties.description: Gets the base name of the node without the namespace prefix, if one exists, in the Document Object Model (DOM). Read-only.

properties.name: ChildNodes
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLNodes collection containing all of the child elements of the current node. Read-only.

properties.name: FirstChild
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLNode object corresponding to the first child element of the current node. If the node has no child elements (or if it isn't of type msoCustomXMLNodeElement), returns Nothing. Read-only.

properties.name: LastChild
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLNode object corresponding to the last child element of the current node. If the node has no child elements (or if it is not of type msoCustomXMLNodeElement), the property returns Nothing. Read-only.

properties.name: NamespaceURI
properties.description: Gets the unique address identifier for the namespace of the CustomXMLNode object. Read-only.

properties.name: NextSibling
properties.description: Gets the next sibling node (element, comment, or processing instruction) of the current node. If the node is the last sibling at its level, the property returns Nothing. Read-only.

properties.name: NodeType
properties.description: Gets the type of the current node. Read-only.

properties.name: NodeValue
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the current node. Read/write.

properties.name: OwnerDocument
properties.description: Gets the object representing the Microsoft Excel workbook, PowerPoint presentation, or Word document associated with this node. Read-only.

properties.name: OwnerPart
properties.description: Gets the object representing the part associated with this node. Read-only.

properties.name: PreviousSibling
properties.description: Gets the previous sibling node (element, comment, or processing instruction) of the current node. If the current node is the first sibling at its level, the property returns Nothing. Read-only.

properties.name: ParentNode
properties.description: Gets the parent element node of the current node. If the current node is at the root level, the property returns Nothing. Read-only.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Gets or sets the text for the current node. Read/write.

properties.name: XPath
properties.description: Gets a String with the canonicalized XPath for the current node. If the node is no longer in the Document Object Model (DOM), the property returns an error message. Read-only.

properties.name: XML
properties.description: Gets the XML representation of the current node and its children, if any exist. Read-only.

methods.name: AppendChildNode
methods.signature: AppendChildNode([Name As String], [NamespaceURI As String], [NodeType As MsoCustomXMLNodeType], [NodeValue As String])
methods.description: Appends a single node as the last child under the context element node in the tree.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Represents the base name of the element to be appended.

parameters.name: NamespaceURI
parameters.description: Represents the namespace of the element to be appended. This parameter is required to append nodes of type msoCustomXMLNodeElement or msoCustomXMLNodeAttribute; otherwise, it is ignored.

parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of node to append. If the parameter is not specified, it is assumed to be of type msoCustomXMLNodeElement.

parameters.name: NodeValue
parameters.description: Used to set the value of the appended node for those nodes that allow text. If the node doesn't allow text, the parameter is ignored.

methods.name: AppendChildSubtree
methods.description: Adds a subtree as the last child under the context element node in the tree.

parameters.name: XML
parameters.description: Represents the subtree to add.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the current node from the tree (including all of its children, if any exist).

methods.name: HasChildNodes
methods.description: Gets True if the current element node has child element nodes.

methods.name: InsertNodeBefore
methods.signature: InsertNodeBefore([Name As String], [NamespaceURI As String], [NodeType As MsoCustomXMLNodeType], [NodeValue As String], [NextSibling As CustomXMLNode])
methods.description: Inserts a new node just before the context node in the tree.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Represents the base name of the node to be added.

parameters.name: NamespaceURI
parameters.description: Represents the namespace of the element to be added. This parameter is required if adding nodes of type msoCustomXMLNodeElement or msoCustomXMLNodeAttribute; otherwise, it is ignored.

parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of the node to be added. If the parameter is not specified, it is assumed to be a node of type msoCustomXMLNodeElement.

parameters.name: NodeValue
parameters.description: Used to set the value of the node to be added for those nodes that allow text. If the node doesn't allow text, the parameter is ignored.

parameters.name: NextSibling
parameters.description: Represents the context node.

methods.name: InsertSubtreeBefore
methods.description: Inserts the specified subtree into the location just before the context node.

parameters.name: XML
parameters.description: Represents the subtree to be added.

parameters.name: NextSibling
parameters.description: Specifies the context node.

methods.name: RemoveChild
methods.description: Removes the specified child node from the tree.

parameters.name: Child
parameters.description: Represents the child node of the context node.

methods.name: ReplaceChildNode
methods.signature: ReplaceChildNode(OldNode As CustomXMLNode, [Name As String], [NamespaceURI As String], [NodeType As MsoCustomXMLNodeType], [NodeValue As String])
methods.description: Removes the specified child node (and its subtree) from the main tree, and replaces it with a different node in the same location.

parameters.name: OldNode
parameters.description: Represents the child node to be replaced.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Represents the base name of the element to be added.

parameters.name: NamespaceURI
parameters.description: Represents the namespace of the element to be added. This parameter is required if adding nodes of type msoCustomXMLNodeElement or msoCustomXMLNodeAttribute; otherwise, it is ignored.

parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of node to add. If the parameter is not specified, it is assumed to be of type msoCustomXMLNodeElement.

parameters.name: NodeValue
parameters.description: Used to set the value of the node to be added for those nodes that allow text. If the node doesn't allow text, the parameter is ignored.

methods.name: ReplaceChildSubtree
methods.signature: ReplaceChildSubtree(XML As String, OldNode As CustomXMLNode)
methods.description: Removes the specified node (and its subtree) from the main tree, and replaces it with a different subtree in the same location.

parameters.name: XML
parameters.description: Represents the subtree to be added.

parameters.name: OldNode
parameters.description: Represents the child node to be replaced.

methods.name: SelectNodes
methods.description: Selects a collection of nodes matching an XPath expression. This method differs from the CustomXMLPart.SelectNodes method in that the XPath expression will be evaluated starting with the 'expression' node as the context node.

parameters.name: XPath
parameters.description: Contains an XPath expression.

methods.name: SelectSingleNode
methods.description: Selects a single node from a collection matching an XPath expression. This method differs from the CustomXMLPart.SelectSingleNode method in that the XPath expression will be evaluated starting with the 'expression' node as the context node.

parameters.name: XPath
parameters.description: Contains an XPath expression.
